name: visualautomate-sdk
description: The VisualAutomate plugin SDK and CLI.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @visualautomate/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @visualautomate/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/sdk.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs test/local-sandbox.test.mjs test/package.test.mjs
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm publish --workspaces --access public
